name: Annual leave (Nghỉ hằng năm)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.113(1) — 12 working days for an employee working in normal conditions, 14 for a minor, a disabled employee or work that is arduous, toxic or dangerous, 16 for work that is especially arduous, toxic or dangerous; art.113(2) proportions it to the months worked in a partial year; art.114 adds one day for every five years of service with the same employer. Applied 2026-09-18: art.113(1) twelve, fourteen (arduous, a minor, a person with a disability: `employee.disabled`) or sixteen (especially arduous) days, and art.114 one more for every five years of service with no ceiling (`days` as a number over the person).

name: Sick leave (Nghỉ ốm đau)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.43 — 30 working days a year under 15 years of contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30 years and 60 from 30 years, raised to 40, 50 and 70 for arduous, toxic or dangerous work; art.42 pays the days from the social insurance fund at 75% of the contribution salary of the preceding month, and art.47 requires the certificate of leave for social insurance benefit from the first day. Applied 2026-09-18: the bands count years of social-insurance contribution (Law 41/2024 art.43; `facts.SI.since_months`); the days are paid by the fund at 75% of the last contribution salary, not by the employer (`paid_by: FUND`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Law on Social Insurance 2024 art.43(1)(b): the longer bands are for work that is arduous, toxic or dangerous, or especially so (`classification in [ARDUOUS, ESPECIALLY_ARDUOUS]`).

name: Maternity leave (Nghỉ thai sản)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) with Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53 — six months before and after childbirth, one further month for each child from the second in a multiple birth, paid from the social insurance fund at 100% of the average contribution salary of the six months before the leave. Applied 2026-09-18: six months per birth, one more for every further child of a multiple birth (art.139(1); one further month read for a twin or more), for a member of six months’ contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law 41/2024 art.50; `facts.SI.since_months`); paid by the fund at the six-month average, not by the employer (`paid_by: FUND`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Labour Code 2019 art.139: every female employee has the six months’ leave; the allowance is the fund’s (`paid_by: FUND`) and needs six months of contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law on Social Insurance 2024 art.50) — a mother short of it is on leave without the allowance, not without the leave.

name: Paternity leave (Nghỉ khi vợ sinh con)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53(2) — five working days for an insured father, seven where the birth is by caesarean section or before 32 weeks, ten for twins with three more for each further child, and fourteen for twins delivered by caesarean section; the leave must fall within 60 days of the birth. Applied 2026-09-18: five working days per birth, seven for a caesarean or a birth before 32 weeks, ten for twins and fourteen for twins by caesarean (Law 41/2024 art.53(2); `event.kind`); paid by the fund (`paid_by: FUND`).

name: Marriage leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — kết hôn)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(a) — three days of paid leave on the employee's own marriage. Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).

name: Child's marriage leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — con kết hôn)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(a) — one day of paid leave on the marriage of the employee's natural or adopted child. Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).

name: Bereavement leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — tang)

name: Unpaid personal leave (Nghỉ không hưởng lương — Điều 115(2))

authority: Labour Code 2019 art.112(1) — eleven days of paid public holiday a year: New Year's Day, five days of Lunar New Year, Hung Kings Commemoration Day, Reunification Day, International Labour Day and two days of National Day.

name: Public holiday in lieu
Foreign employee national days (Tết cổ truyền và Quốc khánh của nước họ)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.112(2) — "Lao động là người nước ngoài làm việc tại Việt Nam ngoài các ngày nghỉ theo quy định tại khoản 1 Điều này còn được nghỉ thêm 01 ngày Tết cổ truyền dân tộc và 01 ngày Quốc khánh của nước họ." Two further paid days on top of art.112(1), for a foreign employee only. name: Work stoppage — employer’s fault (Ngừng việc do lỗi của người sử dụng lao động)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.99(1): the full contract wage. Applied 2026-09-28: a fully paid day, nothing deducted. name: Work stoppage — the worker’s own fault (Ngừng việc do lỗi của người lao động)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2): the worker at fault is not paid. Applied 2026-09-28: an unpaid day (`is_npl`). name: Work stoppage — a co-worker’s fault (Ngừng việc do lỗi của người lao động khác)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2): other workers of the unit who must stop are paid the agreed rate, not below the minimum wage. Applied 2026-09-28: the agreed share, floored at the minimum wage every day. name: Work stoppage — utility failure, disaster, epidemic, relocation or economic reasons (Ngừng việc theo Điều 99(3))

name: Annual leave (Nghỉ hằng năm)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.113(1) — 12 working days for an employee working in normal conditions, 14 for a minor, a disabled employee or work that is arduous, toxic or dangerous, 16 for work that is especially arduous, toxic or dangerous; art.113(2) proportions it to the months worked in a partial year; art.114 adds one day for every five years of service with the same employer. Applied 2026-09-18: art.113(1) twelve, fourteen (arduous, a minor, a person with a disability: `employee.disabled`) or sixteen (especially arduous) days, and art.114 one more for every five years of service with no ceiling (`days` as a number over the person).

name: Sick leave (Nghỉ ốm đau)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.43 — 30 working days a year under 15 years of contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30 years and 60 from 30 years, raised to 40, 50 and 70 for arduous, toxic or dangerous work; art.42 pays the days from the social insurance fund at 75% of the contribution salary of the preceding month, and art.47 requires the certificate of leave for social insurance benefit from the first day. name: Maternity leave (Nghỉ thai sản)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) with Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53 — six months before and after childbirth, one further month for each child from the second in a multiple birth, paid from the social insurance fund at 100% of the average contribution salary of the six months before the leave. name: Paternity leave (Nghỉ khi vợ sinh con)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53(2) — five working days for an insured father, seven where the birth is by caesarean section or before 32 weeks, ten for twins with three more for each further child, and fourteen for twins delivered by caesarean section; the leave must fall within 60 days of the birth. name: Marriage leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — kết hôn)
authority: Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(a) — three days of paid leave on the employee's own marriage. Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).

name: Child's marriage leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — con kết hôn)

name: Bereavement leave (Nghỉ việc riêng — tang)

name: Unpaid personal leave (Nghỉ không hưởng lương — Điều 115(2))
